name: Difficult Terrain
desc: Moving through difficult terrain — such as rubble, dense undergrowth, a swamp, or deep snow — costs 1 extra foot of movement for every foot moved. Difficult terrain isn't cumulative: a square that is difficult for two reasons still costs only 1 extra foot of movement per foot.
